question: Using Section 7B.05 and Figure 7B-2, describe the required sign sequence for entering and leaving a reduced school speed-limit zone.
model_answer: Direct Answer: When a reduced school speed limit zone is established, drivers approaching the zone must first encounter a School (S1-1) sign in advance, then the School Speed Limit assembly or School Speed Limit When Flashing (S5-1) sign placed at or as near as practicable to the point where the zone begins. Where advance notice is appropriate (e.g., a speed reduction of more than 10 mph), a Reduced School Speed Limit Ahead (S4-5 or S4-5a) sign should precede the assembly. The downstream end of the zone must be identified with an END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign. Standards (mandatory): - "A School Speed Limit assembly (see Figure 7B-1) or a School Speed Limit When Flashing (S5-1) sign (see Figure 7B-1) shall be used to indicate the speed limit where a reduced school speed limit zone has been established... The School Speed Limit assembly or School Speed Limit When Flashing sign shall be placed at or as near as practicable to the point where the reduced school speed limit zone begins (see Figures 7B-2 and 7B-4)." - "If a reduced school speed limit zone has been established, a School (S1-1) sign shall be installed in advance (see Table 2C-3 for advance placement guidelines) of the first School Speed Limit sign assembly or S5-1 sign that is encountered in each direction as traffic approaches the reduced school speed limit zone (see Figures 7B-2 and 7B-4)." - "If used, the Reduced School Speed Limit Ahead sign shall be followed by a School Speed Limit sign or a School Speed Limit assembly." - "Except as provided in Paragraph 4 of this Section, the downstream end of an authorized and posted reduced school speed limit zone shall be identified with an END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign (see Figures 7B-1, 7B-2, and 7B-4)." - Where higher fines apply only to speeding: "a FINES HIGHER (R2-6P), FINES DOUBLE (R2-6aP), or $XX FINE (R2-6bP) plaque shall be posted with the School Speed Limit (S5-1) sign and shall not be posted beneath the School Zone (S1-1) sign." Guidance (recommended): - "A Reduced School Speed Limit Ahead (S4-5 or S4-5a) sign (see Figure 7B-1) should be used to inform road users of a reduced speed zone where the speed limit is being reduced by more than 10 mph, or where engineering judgment indicates that advance notice would be appropriate." Visual evidence: - [Image 1] Figure 7B-2 illustrates the full sequence in each travel direction: an advance School (S1-1) sign with optional SCHOOL (S4-3P) plaque, a Reduced School Speed Limit Ahead (S4-5) sign, the School Speed Limit assembly (S4-3P/R2-1/S4-1P) at the start of the zone, and an END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign — or END SCHOOL ZONE (S5-2) — with an optional Speed Limit 45 (R2-1) sign at the downstream end. - [Image 2] Figure 7B-1 depicts the individual signs and assemblies used in the sequence, including the School Speed Limit assembly (S4-3P + R2-1 + S4-1P or alternative plaques), the S5-1 WHEN FLASHING sign, the S4-5/S4-5a Reduced School Speed Limit Ahead signs, and the END SCHOOL ZONE (S5-2) and END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) signs. - [Image 3] This page presents the Section 7B.05 Standard text requiring the School Speed Limit assembly/S5-1 at the beginning of the zone, the advance S1-1 sign, and the S5-3 sign at the downstream end. - [Image 4] This page shows Section 7B.06 provisions on fines plaques posted with the School Speed Limit sign and related end-of-zone options. - [Image 5] This full-page view of Figure 7B-2 confirms the layout of the entering/leaving sign sequence for both directions of travel. - [Image 6] Figure 7B-4 shows the analogous sequence where higher fines apply only for speeding, with fines plaques included in the School Speed Limit assembly. Citations: - Section 7B.05 Standard §1 (p.978) - Section 7B.05 Standard §2 (p.978) - Section 7B.05 Standard §14 (p.980) - Section 7B.05 Standard §3 (p.978) - Section 7B.06 Standard §3 (p.980) - Section 7B.05 Guidance §13 (p.980) - Figure 7B-2 (p.975) - Figure 7B-1 (p.973) - Page 1019 - Page 1024 - Page 1016 - Page 1020
gold_answer: Approaching traffic first encounters an advance School (S1-1) sign, then the School Speed Limit assembly or S5-1 at the beginning of the reduced zone. The downstream end is normally marked by S5-3 END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT; S5-2 END SCHOOL ZONE may be used when both zones end together, with a downstream R2-1 optionally mounted.
